results.reflection:
SUMMARY
This sandtray board contains two circular markers—red and green—placed symmetrically along the x-axis at equal distances from the center (x = −1 and x = 1), both at z = 0. The terrain is flat, with no meaningful relief or height variation. The scene is described as a synthetic test setup, not linked to client data.

OBSERVATIONS
Two visible objects are present: one red marker and one green marker, both categorized as Markers. They are positioned horizontally apart, mirroring each other across the central vertical plane. No other objects, terrain features, enclosures, connections, or groupings appear in the structured data. The sand surface is level, and the tray boundary is brown.

OPTIONAL HYPOTHESES
The symmetrical placement may reflect an intentional balancing of the two markers—but it could also result from practical spacing, aesthetic preference, or experimental design. Their separation may highlight distinction or independence, yet it might equally serve clarity in a test environment. The absence of additional objects or terrain variation may signal focus or simplicity—or simply align with the stated purpose of a synthetic deployment test.

QUESTIONS FOR REFLECTION
What stands out to you about the distance between the red and green markers?
How does the arrangement—two separate items on otherwise open sand—feel to you?
If you were to add or adjust something here, what might that be—and what would guide that choice?

CONCLUSION
This board holds two distinct markers in balanced, separated positions on flat sand. There is no implied meaning in their color, placement, or number—only what you bring to them. Your understanding matters most. Would you like to share what these markers, their spacing, or the open space around them mean to you?

PRACTICE CONTEXT

These notes support the reflection method; they are not evidence about the individual.

[1] The builder determines personal meaning. Follow their language and pace; use open invitations instead of supplying a symbol interpretation. Avoid entering or changing the tray without invitation. Training and consultation support competent practice.

[2] Document the construction sequence, sand use, placements and the creator’s words, alongside relevant context and changes across sessions. Keep recorded events distinct from the therapist’s reflections. A finished-tray image cannot supply missing process or history.

[3] Professional AI use requires attention to transparency, privacy, bias, evidence and human oversight. A model-generated reflection needs professional review; an apparently fluent answer does not establish clinical validity.

https://www.txsandtray.org/best-practices

https://www.isst-society.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Guidelines_final_case_study.pdf

[3] APA — Ethical guidance for AI in professional practice
https://www.apa.org/topics/artificial-intelligence-machine-learning/ethical-guidance-ai-professional-practice

results.reflection:
摘要
这是一个合成测试沙盘，包含两个可见物件：一枚红色标记与一枚绿色标记，均置于沙面中央区域，x轴坐标分别为-1和1，z轴坐标均为0，呈水平对称分布。沙盘地形平坦，无明显起伏，边界为棕色托盘边缘。

观察
两枚标记在水平方向上彼此分离，间距约2单位；它们大小相同、类别一致（均为Markers），且未与其他物件或地形特征形成围合、连接或遮挡关系。沙面整体空旷，标记周围留有大量未使用空间。无其他物件、沙形变化或结构化地形存在。

可选假设
这种对称分置可能反映创作者对平衡布局的主动选择；但也可能仅出于测试操作的便利性，例如依次点击左右位置。两枚标记颜色不同但类别相同，其差异是否被赋予特定区分意义，需创作者确认——也可能是软件默认配色，未承载个人意图。

反思问题
这两枚标记之间的距离，对您来说是否有特别的考虑？
当您放置它们时，是否关注过它们彼此的位置关系？
您希望用什么词语来描述这两个标记在沙盘中的状态？

总结
这个沙盘简洁清晰：两个同类型、不同颜色的标记在平坦沙面上保持水平分离。所有观察均基于可见结构数据，不涉及推断情绪、关系或象征。沙盘的意义始终由创作者定义——欢迎您用自己的语言，为它们的位置、颜色或共存方式赋予属于您的解释。

实践参考

以下资料支持反思方法，不证明对个人的判断。

[1] 沙盘创作者决定其个人意义。跟随其语言与节奏，以开放邀请代替替对方解释象征。未经邀请不进入或改变沙盘。专业训练与督导支持胜任实践。

[2] 记录制作顺序、用沙方式、摆放、创作者原话，以及相关背景和跨次变化。把实际事件与治疗师的思考分开。完成后的沙盘照片不能补足缺失的过程或历史。

[3] 专业使用AI应注意透明度、隐私、偏差、证据与人工监督。模型生成的反思需要专业审阅，语言流畅并不能证明临床有效性。

资料来源
